crossRefs.note: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

translations.web: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
translations.bsb: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
translations.kjv: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
translations.asv: behold now, thy servant hath found favor in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy lovingkindness, which thou hast showed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die:
